summary: AppTech Payments Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 29, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with GS Capital Partners, LLC for a $560,000 promissory note plus 80,000 common shares. The note carries a $55,000 original issue discount, yielding $505,000 gross proceeds, pays 10% interest, and matures November 28, 2027, with six $87,000 principal payments starting 180 days after issuance. It is convertible at a fixed $2.00 per share, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, with default conversion at an 80% VWAP discount. Watch dilution and default-trigger overhang.
